task_title: AUG-121: model each Auger task as a scoped XML spec with in/out references, acceptance+verification refs and ch:trace links
task_criteria: AC1 - a task XML block's stable id, lifecycle/version, in-scope refs, out-of-scope refs with reasons, acceptance refs and verification methods are typed and resolve to existing blocks. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=/home/kara/auger/.venv/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_task_scope_contract. FAILIF: the test fails, is not collected, or pytest reports fewer than 1 passed.

AC2 - duplicate, missing, inactive-without-acknowledgment and cross-version spec references are refused with a typed finding naming the exact task and block ids and emitting no partial task packet. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=/home/kara/auger/.venv/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_a_task_naming_a_missing_block_is_refused tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_multiple_scope_refusals_are_typed tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_inactive_reference_needs_acknowledgment tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_a_cross_version_reference_is_refused tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_out_of_scope_entry_without_a_reason_is_refused. FAILIF: any of the five tests fails or fewer than 5 pass.

AC3 - given an approved plan digest, exporting one task through boardctl records the exact in-scope and excluded block ids plus their source version in supported fields and the readback matches. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=/home/kara/auger/.venv/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_approved_plan_digest_exports_one_board_row. FAILIF: the test fails, is not collected, or the readback differs from the approved packet.

AC4 - given an unapproved or stale plan digest, boardctl is not invoked and both canonical JSONL files stay byte-identical. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=/home/kara/auger/.venv/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_unapproved_or_stale_digest_leaves_the_board_untouched. FAILIF: the test fails or is not collected.

AC5 - a task packet's ch:trace marker resolves row and spec to the canonical task and exact XML ids, while absent evidence/verdict/commit fields use none:reason. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=/home/kara/auger/.venv/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_the_generated_trace_marker_resolves. FAILIF: the test fails or a marker field is missing instead of carrying none:reason.

AC6 - out of scope holds: the exporter invokes only boardctl create/readback with no scheduler mutation client, and its proof file is named in the gate pytest arm. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=/home/kara/auger/.venv/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_the_exporter_only_invokes_boardctl_create_and_readback tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_gate_arm_runs_these_files. FAILIF: either test fails, or tests/gate.sh does not name tests/test_xml_task_contract.py.

PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=/home/kara/auger/.venv/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_task_scope_contract. items.detail: Ran the exact proof command: `python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_task_scope_contract` -> ". [100%] / 1 passed in 0.05s" (exit 0). The test (tests/test_xml_task_contract.py:186-253) asserts the packet's typed fields (task/source/status/version/method/scope_version; in_scope/acceptance/out_of_scope entries each carrying kind/status/version/method/source/edge; exclusion reason) and cross-checks every named id against `spec list` output so an invented id cannot survive. Grammar support: specs/schema/auger-spec-1.0.xsd:236-256 (taskType extends blockType with in-scope/out-of-scope/acceptance/acknowledges/scope-version/plan-digest) and validator auger.py:8601-8705.

items.criterion: AC2 - duplicate, missing, inactive-without-acknowledgment and cross-version spec references are refused with a typed finding naming the exact task and block ids and emitting no partial task packet. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=/home/kara/auger/.venv/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_a_task_naming_a_missing_block_is_refused tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_multiple_scope_refusals_are_typed tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_inactive_reference_needs_acknowledgment tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_a_cross_version_reference_is_refused tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_out_of_scope_entry_without_a_reason_is_refused. FAILIF: any of the five tests fails or fewer than 5 pass.
items.detail: Ran the exact proof command: "..... [100%] / 5 passed in 0.24s" (exit 0). Codes implemented at auger.py:8621-8705 (task-scope-missing, task-duplicate-reference, task-scope-conflict, task-invalid-acceptance-ref, inactive-reference-unacknowledged, missing-exclusion-reason, unexpected-exclusion, cross-version-reference), each message naming the task id and the block id. The tests also assert `out == ""` (no partial packet) and that `spec task-packet` itself refuses with exit 2 and empty stdout (tests/test_xml_task_contract.py:256-270).

items.criterion: AC3 - given an approved plan digest, exporting one task through boardctl records the exact in-scope and excluded block ids plus their source version in supported fields and the readback matches. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=/home/kara/auger/.venv/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_approved_plan_digest_exports_one_board_row. FAILIF: the test fails, is not collected, or the readback differs from the approved packet.
items.detail: The stated proof does not pass — it SKIPS. `cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=/home/kara/auger/.venv/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_approved_plan_digest_exports_one_board_row` -> "s [100%] / SKIPPED [1] tests/test_xml_task_contract.py:393: boardctl is not installed on this host ... the AC3/AC4/AC6 proofs did NOT run here / 1 skipped in 0.01s". boardctl IS installed on the host at /home/kara/.local/bin/boardctl, but that directory is absent from the proof PATH (verified: under the proof PATH, `python3 -c "import shutil;print(shutil.which('boardctl'))"` -> None). The skip is a PATH artifact of the proof command, not a missing dependency, and a skip is not a pass. With /home/kara/.local/bin added the whole file runs "11 passed in 0.26s", so the implementation looks correct — but the criterion's own proof command never executed the readback assertion.

items.criterion: AC4 - given an unapproved or stale plan digest, boardctl is not invoked and both canonical JSONL files stay byte-identical. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=/home/kara/auger/.venv/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_unapproved_or_stale_digest_leaves_the_board_untouched. FAILIF: the test fails or is not collected.
items.detail: The stated proof SKIPS: `... python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_unapproved_or_stale_digest_leaves_the_board_untouched` -> "s [100%] / 1 skipped in 0.01s", skip raised at tests/test_xml_task_contract.py:393 (boardctl not on the proof PATH; it lives at /home/kara/.local/bin/boardctl). The byte-identical-hash and recording-wrapper assertions (tests/test_xml_task_contract.py:527-583) therefore never ran under the stated proof. They do pass when /home/kara/.local/bin is on PATH (full-file run: 11 passed in 0.26s), so this is a proof-command defect rather than a demonstrated code defect — but the criterion as written is not satisfied by the given command.

items.criterion: AC5 - a task packet's ch:trace marker resolves row and spec to the canonical task and exact XML ids, while absent evidence/verdict/commit fields use none:reason. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=/home/kara/auger/.venv/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_the_generated_trace_marker_resolves. FAILIF: the test fails or a marker field is missing instead of carrying none:reason.
items.detail: Ran the exact proof command: ". [100%] / 1 passed in 0.05s" (exit 0). tests/test_xml_task_contract.py:585-637 asserts row=SG7-TASK-1, spec=tasks.xml#SG7-TASK-1, test=<path>::<selector>, and that evidence/verdict/commit each start with "none:" and are longer than 5 characters (a reason, not a bare none); it also asserts a bare `none` raises SpecError code "unexplained-absent-field" and an unknown field raises "unknown-trace-field". Implementation: auger.py:9626-9660 render_task_trace_marker (defaults none:no-evidence-recorded / none:not-judged / none:not-implemented), auger.py:9694-9743 parse_trace_marker, auger.py:9745+ resolve_trace_marker.

items.criterion: AC6 - out of scope holds: the exporter invokes only boardctl create/readback with no scheduler mutation client, and its proof file is named in the gate pytest arm. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=/home/kara/auger/.venv/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_the_exporter_only_invokes_boardctl_create_and_readback tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_gate_arm_runs_these_files. FAILIF: either test fails, or tests/gate.sh does not name tests/test_xml_task_contract.py.
items.detail: Ran the exact proof command: "s. [100%] / 1 passed, 1 skipped in 0.01s". The substantive half — test_the_exporter_only_invokes_boardctl_create_and_readback, which records every boardctl argv through a wrapper and asserts operations == {create, show} plus scans export_task_packet/_boardctl source for urllib/http.client/requests/socket/scheduler/tick — SKIPPED at tests/test_xml_task_contract.py:393 because the proof PATH omits /home/kara/.local/bin where boardctl lives. Only the gate-arm test ran. The gate arm itself is correct: tests/gate.sh:206 names tests/test_xml_task_contract.py. A skip is not a pass, so the criterion's substance (only create/readback invoked) was not executed by the stated proof.

items.criterion: The `spec task-packet` and `spec task-export` verbs are reachable from the CLI entrypoint (argparse registration + dispatch), not just importable functions.
items.detail: Both verbs are registered on the `spec` subparser (auger.py:14156 task-packet, auger.py:14174 task-export, both set_defaults(fn=cmd_spec)) and dispatched in cmd_spec (auger.py:12674-12677 -> cmd_spec_task_packet / cmd_spec_task_export, defined at auger.py:11814 and 11835). Live CLI check: `python3 auger.py spec task-packet --help` prints "usage: auger spec task-packet [-h] --task ID root"; `python3 auger.py spec task-export --help` prints "usage: auger spec task-export [-h] --task ID --board DIR [--plan-digest SHA256] [--boardctl PATH] root".

items.criterion: The exporter's refusal path (unapproved/stale/invalid digest) raises a typed SpecError BEFORE any boardctl call, so no partial row can be written.
items.detail: export_task_packet (auger.py:9876-9960) runs load_spec_corpus -> task_packet -> require_approved_plan(packet, declared) before the first _board_readback/_boardctl call; require_approved_plan (auger.py:9595-9625) raises typed SpecError unapproved-plan-digest / invalid-plan-digest / stale-plan-digest. The only boardctl calls in the function are _board_readback (show) and the create argv, both after the digest gate. The external proof (recording wrapper whose log must not exist, tests/test_xml_task_contract.py:527-583) passes when boardctl is on PATH (full-file run: 11 passed).

items.criterion: The task-scope grammar is enforced by the shipped XSD (taskType extends blockType; <exclusion> only meaningful inside a task) and the existing XSD/spec suites stay green.
items.detail: specs/schema/auger-spec-1.0.xsd:236-256 defines taskType as an xs:extension of auger:blockType adding in-scope/out-of-scope/acceptance/acknowledges/scope-version/plan-digest, with <xs:element name="task" type="auger:taskType" substitutionGroup="auger:block"/>; <exclusion ref reason> is declared at :263-270 and joined to blockType's choice at :172, with the code refusing it outside a task (auger.py:8689 unexpected-exclusion). Existing suites stay green: `python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xsd_conformance.py tests/test_xml_specs.py tests/test_spec_context.py` -> "80 passed in 1.53s".

items.criterion: The proof file is actually executed by the repo's configured test command (tests/gate.sh pytest arm), so the ACs are not dead coverage.
items.detail: tests/gate.sh:206 (the single `python3 -m pytest` arm) names tests/test_xml_task_contract.py, and .gitreins/config.yaml sets guards.test_command: bash tests/gate.sh, so the proof file is executed by the repo's configured test command. test_gate_arm_runs_these_files asserts the same and passed ("1 passed" in the AC6 run).

items.criterion: Re-exporting the same approved packet is idempotent (one row, status=unchanged) rather than creating a duplicate row.
items.detail: export_task_packet (auger.py:9930-9945) reads the existing row via _board_readback first; when capability_tags and reasoning are identical it returns outcome("unchanged", existing) without a create, and a differing row raises board-row-conflict. test_an_approved_plan_digest_exports_one_board_row re-exports and asserts status == "unchanged" and rows_with_id(...) == 1 (tests/test_xml_task_contract.py:517-524); that test passes with boardctl on PATH (full-file run: 11 passed in 0.26s).
